title: Open Wide
subtitle: AR and AH — the deep open vowel
description: The AR and AH vowel sounds require a fully dropped jaw and a wide-open mouth, which is exactly what the cork trains. This exercise focuses on the broad, resonant openness used in British, Australian, and received pronunciation English.
tip: On every AR sound, feel the cork helping you drop your jaw all the way — this is the correct jaw position for this vowel.
phrases: Father are you a farmer from far away
Barbara bought a large jar of marmalade
The dark barn was far from the car park
Are you going to start the car after dark
Hard work starts with a calm heart
The star shines hard and far past the palm trees
